defects.claim: Description: 'Face the wall directly and press both palms flat against it at shoulder height, arms extended. Walk the feet back and lean the torso in toward the wall, creating a strong diagonal.' Requires FORWARD torso lean toward wall (spine POSITIVE per CORRECTED convention 'spine + = forward lean'). PR-v3 comment (line 773 of poses-data.js) claims 'description says back arch but spine is positive (forward fold). Was spine:14, now spine:-14.' — PR-v3 MISFIRED: it interpreted unspecified 'back' cues as 'back arch' but the description explicitly says 'lean the torso in toward the wall' (forward toward wall in front of body). Current spine=-14 produces torso_flexion -14° (backward arch, AWAY from wall). Shoulders at z=-0.135 (behind hips), head at z=-0.194 (behind). Same defect class as stool-lean-back, p12-wall-s3, glass-lean, low-wall-sit (PR-v3 misfires on context-ambiguous 'back' wording).
